SEPARATING: a width-aware comparison answers false at 72.

entries.name: bare-string-operands-errored#26
entries.script: [S0] `"a" == "a"`, two String constants — THROWS `RuntimeException: Unknown type SString` at `EQ`'s operand check, before the comparer: `SType.isValueOfType` has no String case. A different exception from the `InterpreterException` of a lie at the root (EQ.cross_width_numeric W3), though the eval tier grades both as errored; a String reaches the comparer only inside a pair (S1-S5). SEPARATING: an operand check with a String case answers true.

entries.script: [S1] `("a",1) == ("a",1)`, two `(String, Int)` pair constants — true at cost 35: a String left charges `MatchType` 1 and, the lengths being equal, `EQ_COA_Short` over the length (15 + 2 per 96-char chunk: 17), then the Int item 3. Pins the String case's cost.
